label: Arranges funerals
true_when: arranges funerals as a funeral director (not only a crematorium, cemetery, florist or stonemason)

label: Independent or family-owned
faq: Which {plural} in {city} are independent or family-owned?
true_when: describes itself in words as independent, family-run or family-owned, and names no parent group or co-operative

label: Part of a larger group
faq: Which {plural} in {city} belong to a national group or co-operative?
true_when: states that it is part of, or trades as, a larger group or co-operative (for example Co-op Funeralcare, Dignity, Funeral Partners, a regional co-operative)
pattern: funeralcare|co-?op(erative)?( society)?|dignity (funerals|plc)|part of dignity|funeral partners|part of the [a-z ]+ group|a [a-z ]*group company

label: Prices published online
faq: Which {plural} in {city} publish their prices online?
true_when: publishes its prices, a price list or a Standardised Price List on its own website
pattern: standardised price list|price list|our prices|pricing|funeral costs?|£\s?\d

label: Direct cremation
true_when: offers a direct, unattended or simple cremation without a funeral service

label: Chapel of rest
faq: Which {plural} in {city} have a chapel of rest?
true_when: has a chapel of rest or private viewing room where families can visit
pattern: chapels? of rest|private chapel|viewing room|visit(ing)? (your|the) loved one

label: Own mortuary
faq: Which {plural} in {city} have their own mortuary?
true_when: states it has its own, on-site or in-house mortuary or care facilities

label: Green or natural burial
faq: Which {plural} in {city} arrange green or natural burials?
true_when: arranges green, natural or woodland burials or eco-friendly funerals

label: Specific faith traditions
faq: Which {plural} in {city} arrange funerals for specific faiths?
true_when: names experience with one or more specific faith traditions (for example Muslim, Jewish, Hindu, Sikh, Orthodox)

label: Non-religious and humanist
faq: Which {plural} in {city} arrange non-religious or humanist funerals?
true_when: arranges non-religious, humanist or celebrant-led funerals

label: Repatriation
true_when: arranges repatriation into or out of the UK

label: Home arrangement visits
faq: Which {plural} in {city} will visit families at home?
true_when: offers to visit the family at home to make arrangements
pattern: home visits?|visit (you|families) (at|in your) home|in (the comfort of )?your (own )?home

label: Available 24 hours
faq: Which {plural} in {city} answer the phone 24 hours a day?
true_when: states it is available 24 hours a day, every day, or day and night

label: Funeral plans
faq: Which {plural} in {city} offer pre-paid funeral plans?
true_when: offers or arranges pre-paid funeral plans (the plan provider must be FCA-authorised; that is checked separately, never inferred)
pattern: pre-?paid funeral plans?|funeral plans?|pre-?arranged funerals?|plan(ning)? ahead

label: NAFD or SAIF member
faq: Which {plural} in {city} belong to the NAFD or SAIF?
true_when: states membership of the National Association of Funeral Directors (NAFD) or the National Society of Allied and Independent Funeral Directors (SAIF)
pattern: \bNAFD\b|national association of funeral directors|\bSAIF\b|allied (and|&) independent funeral directors
